title: NPS denied access (Event 6273)
plain_english: Network Policy Server denied this connection attempt. The decisive detail is the 'Reason Code' line of the event — if a more specific diagnosis appears above this one, that's your answer. If this generic result is all you got, the pasted text is probably missing the Reason Code / Reason lines.

any: Network Policy Server denied access to a user

causes.cause: The pasted event text is incomplete — the Reason Code and Reason lines carry the actual diagnosis.
causes.next_check: In Event Viewer, right-click the 6273 event → 'Copy details as text', and paste the WHOLE event including the Authentication Details section.

causes.cause: The failure has a Reason Code this analyzer doesn't know yet.
causes.next_check: Read the 'Reason:' line of the event — it is Microsoft's own one-line explanation — and consider opening an issue so a rule can be added for it.
